Name: Female Alex - Genderbend with Seasonal Outfit and Dialogue
Author: Azuyorou
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Changes Alex's appearance and dialogue to a female version. 

- Portraits and Sprites will change depending on the season. 
- Replaced dialogues to make sure everyone refers Alex as a lady. 
- Alex will no longer going to workout in the Men's Locker.

You can revert the changes through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][/url]

[size=4][font=Arial][b]Requirements[/b][/font][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Extract the folder [i][color=#ffe599]"[/color][color=#fff2cc][CP] Female Alex-Portraits-Sprites-Dialogue"[/color] and [color=#fff2cc]"[CP] The Bedroom Door"[/color][/i] into the Mods folder

[b][size=4]Programs Used[/size][/b]
Aseprite, Microsoft Visual Studio Code
